title: Legalise cannabis for adults
summary: Legalise Cannabis Victoria's central platform is to legalise cannabis use by adults in Victoria, ending criminal penalties for consumption.
excerpt: Thousands of people are needlessly funneled into the criminal justice system every year because the consumption of cannabis is prohibited in Victoria by outdated laws.

title: Regulated market for tested, labelled cannabis
summary: The party's election material calls for a regulated supply of tested and labelled cannabis with quality controls, which it says would reduce reliance on the black market.
sourceTitle: Legalise Cannabis Victoria how-to-vote card – Eastern Victoria Region (VEC)
excerpt: REGULATE PROPERLY Tested, labelled cannabis with quality controls, reducing reliance on the black market and criminal gangs.

title: Cannabis plebiscite on legalisation
summary: The party proposed a (non-binding) plebiscite asking Victorians whether they support legalising cannabis; the motion was defeated in Parliament in October 2026 and the party says it is taking the issue to the election.
sourceTitle: Legalise Cannabis Victoria Takes the Fight for Reform to the People
excerpt: Our proposal was really simple – if the major parities can’t get the job done on cannabis law reform, let the people decide.

title: Legislate cautions instead of arrests for small cannabis possession
summary: The party wants legislation requiring police to issue a caution rather than arrest people found with less than 50g of cannabis and no other offence; Parliament supported its motion to investigate this in May 2026.
sourceTitle: Huge News: We are One Step Closer to Stopping Arrests for Cannabis in Victoria
excerpt: We asked the Government to legislate cautioning for personal use rather than arrest

title: Protect people from losing jobs or rentals over cannabis records
summary: The party's election material states that nobody should lose their job or rental because of a criminal record for using cannabis.
sourceTitle: Legalise Cannabis Victoria how-to-vote card – Eastern Victoria Region (VEC)
excerpt: PROTECT PEOPLE Nobody should lose their job or rental over a criminal record for using cannabis.

title: Home growing and not-for-profit cannabis clubs (candidate position)
summary: Several Legalise Cannabis Victoria candidates state support for legalisation that lets adults grow their own cannabis and join regulated, not-for-profit clubs. This is stated on candidate pages rather than a party policy document.
sourceTitle: Riley Aickin - Candidate for Northern Metropolitan
excerpt: He supports legalising cannabis, including letting adults grow their own and join regulated, not-for-profit clubs, to take money away from organised crime and free up police time for serious crime.

title: "Let Patients Drive": legal defence for medicinal cannabis users
summary: The party calls for a legal defence for medicinal cannabis prescription holders charged with drug presence while driving, where the medicine was taken as prescribed and they were not impaired.
excerpt: calls on the Victorian Government to immediately establish a legal defence for medicinal cannabis prescription holders who are charged with the presence of drugs in their system, if the medication was taken in accordance with a prescription and they were not impaired when tested.

title: Reform workplace drug testing for medicinal cannabis patients
summary: The party has called on the government to overhaul workplace alcohol and drug testing laws and update WorkSafe guidance so unimpaired medicinal cannabis patients are not dismissed for testing positive.
excerpt: WorkSafe’s guidance on developing workplace AOD policies was last reviewed in 2014, four years before medicinal cannabis was legalised! It contains no information on medicinal cannabis and needs urgent updating.

title: Grow the industrial hemp industry
summary: The party wants Victoria to respond to the parliamentary Inquiry into the Industrial Hemp Industry so that laws better support hemp uses such as textiles, food, bioplastics, construction materials and biofuel.
excerpt: We must respond to the findings of the Inquiry into the Industrial Hemp Industry in Victoria to ensure our laws better support this vital industry.

title: Restore IBAC's power to independently investigate police misconduct
summary: MP Rachel Payne introduced the IBAC Functions Bill 2026 to restore IBAC's power to independently investigate police misconduct, and lists it among her re-election priorities.
sourceTitle: Rachel Payne - Candidate for South-Eastern Metropolitan
excerpt: Introduced the IBAC Functions Bill 2026, to restore IBAC’s power to independently investigate police misconduct.

title: Referendum to abolish Legislative Council regions
summary: The party supports a referendum to abolish the eight Legislative Council regions, which it says would make upper house representation more proportional following the removal of group voting tickets.
excerpt: A referendum is the only way to make changes to the Constitution, which is why last week we insisted that removing GVTs should happen at the same time as a referendum to abolish the regions.
